nere-suffocation-deadline.title: Nere's suffocation deadline
nere-suffocation-deadline.timing: After Nere's in-game warning, resolve the cave-in before leaving or taking another long rest.
nere-suffocation-deadline.consequence: If the cave-in is still unresolved after that warning, leaving or long-resting again runs the story rule that kills Nere and clears the Grymforge camp.

shadowfell-point-of-no-return.title: Shadowfell point of no return
shadowfell-point-of-no-return.timing: Finish unfinished Act 1 and mountain-pass business before entering the Shadowfell.
shadowfell-point-of-no-return.consequence: Entering sets the Act 2 point-of-no-return flag; the game then marks the Wilderness and Githyanki Crèche levels inaccessible.

waukeens-rest-rescue-deadline.title: Waukeen's Rest rescue window
waukeens-rest-rescue-deadline.timing: After entering the burning inn area, rescue Counsellor Florrick before long-resting, leaving the fire area or unloading the Wilderness.
waukeens-rest-rescue-deadline.consequence: Entering the inner fire trigger primes the burn-down state. A long rest, leaving both fire triggers or unloading the Wilderness runs the burn-down procedure; if Florrick was not freed, the rule kills her by incineration.

mirkon-harpy-cove-deadline.title: Mirkon's Harpy Cove deadline
mirkon-harpy-cove-deadline.timing: After entering Harpy Cove, resolve the encounter before long-resting or leaving the Wilderness.
mirkon-harpy-cove-deadline.consequence: If the Harpy Cove encounter is still active after the player entered it, long-resting or unloading the Wilderness runs the unresolved-state transition, kills Mirkon and returns his body to the encounter position.

wyrmwayPuzzle.chessHint: The game randomly selects one of three authored board layouts. Match the current layout, then make its three moves in order.
wyrmwayPuzzle.insightHint: The game marks exactly one apparition as the correct target. The flying books provide the in-world evidence.
wyrmwayPuzzle.justiceHint: Place the correct painting in the empty niche. The game accepts exactly one of the three authored candidates below.
wyrmwayPuzzle.courageHint: Give the torch to one character and keep them alive inside the arena until the trial timer finishes. Enemy groups join in four authored phases.
wyrmwayPuzzle.courageFailure: The trial fails if the torch bearer is defeated or leaves the arena.

crechePuzzle.statueHint: Rotate each statue in {{degrees}}° steps until both authored angle ranges are satisfied.
crechePuzzle.stuckStatue: If the sunset statue is stuck, use grease or oil, deal at least {{damage}} damage in one hit, or pass the Athletics DC {{dc}} check.
crechePuzzle.weaponHint: Each pedestal accepts any weapon of the required proficiency type; the ceremonial versions are optional. The longsword starts in place.
crechePuzzle.wrongWeaponPenalty: A wrong weapon is thrown back for {{damage}} {{type}} damage and {{duration}} turns of knockdown.
crechePuzzle.rewardHint: Solving all four pedestals opens the hidden reward compartment. Its exact contents are listed below on the reward marker.

arcaneTowerTransport.powerHint: The lift works after powering the generator with a {{ingredient}}. While unpowered, using a button triggers an Arcana DC {{dc}} check instead of moving the party.
arcaneTowerTransport.hiddenButton: This button stays hidden unless {{ring}} is equipped nearby.
arcaneTowerTransport.destination: Exact authored arrival point for level {{floor}}.
arcaneTowerTransport.ringHint: Equip this ring near the bottom or top lift zones to reveal their two hidden shortcut buttons.

sharEntrancePuzzle.stepLights: Lower and extinguish all {{braziers}} hanging braziers across the {{corners}} corners.
sharEntrancePuzzle.stepRings: Darkness makes the safe pattern readable: {{detectors}} light detectors control {{rings}} barrier rings. Follow the gaps without crossing a ring.
sharEntrancePuzzle.stepCenter: Reach and use the central switch to disable the barriers and finish the trap sequence.
sharEntrancePuzzle.hazard: Crossing a barrier pushes the character back; triggering the chamber can also flood its ten authored fire points.
sharEntrancePuzzle.removesLock: Using the central switch removes this door's Arcane Lock.
sharEntrancePuzzle.opensDoor: Using the central switch unlocks and opens this door.

balthazarSecretRoom.bodyPartHint: After revealing the heart altar, insert any body part. The game's 12 proposed item restrictions are disabled, so a specific heart is not required.
balthazarSecretRoom.rewardHint: The altar opens the secret bookcase and reveals {{research}}, which contains Balthazar's Nightsong research.

minscSluicePuzzle.solution: Set both gauges to stage {{stage}} at the same time. The matching window lasts {{seconds}} seconds before that stage expires.
minscSluicePuzzle.elemental: Fire or Cold damage applied to either main valve adjusts the Temperature Valve for {{seconds}} seconds, letting you correct its faster cycle.
minscSluicePuzzle.overload: Stage {{overload}} overloads and locks a main valve. Use {{release}} to drop overloaded valves back to stage {{reset}}.
minscSluicePuzzle.bypass: Alternative: force either Sluice Valve with a {{skill}} DC {{dc}} check to unlock the gates directly.
minscSluicePuzzle.disabled: This broken valve is explicitly disabled by the game script and cannot solve or reset the puzzle.
